parties: Siddeshwari Tradex Private Limited (acquirer); Hexa Tradex Limited (target)
headline: Siddeshwari Tradex discloses substantial acquisition in Hexa Tradex under SEBI takeover code
sum: Siddeshwari Tradex Private Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE reporting a substantial acquisition of shares in Hexa Tradex Limited. The filing triggers mandatory disclosure obligations under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures flag acquisitions at or above the 25% threshold or material changes in shareholding; counsel must advise on subsequent open offer obligations, exempt acquisition conditions, and backdoor listing risk if applicable.
detail: Siddeshwari Tradex Private Limited submitted to NSE a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, evidencing a substantial acquisition event in Hexa Tradex Limited. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure when a party acquires 25% or more voting rights or control. This is a foundational disclosure; open offer and other obligations follow statutory timelines. The specific quantum of shares and consideration are not detailed in the regulatory announcement itself.
